observations.why: Directive issued in a settled, confident register — establishing cadence without urgency or alarm, conveying quiet assurance.
Aphoristic framing that stakes urgency on a gap — the speaker presses the consequence of not rehearsing, carrying alarm-as-worry rather than calm assertion.
Declarative cadence entry in a neutral, settled register — confirming a decision without heightened arousal, conveying quiet satisfaction with the arrangement.
Ownership declaration in a flat, confident register — self-assignment without fanfare or anxiety, conveying settled assurance.

mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
